columns.name: Structure
columns.description: Decision rights, approvals, and how decisions get recorded

columns.name: Culture
columns.description: Feedback, recognition, and keeping people informed

ideas.title: Review your own approvals
ideas.summary: Flag one approval you think could sit closer to the person doing the work.
ideas.details: Pick the approval that slows your team most. Propose moving it, try it for a month, and write down what happened.

ideas.title: Remove one unneeded approval
ideas.summary: Find one approval step on your team that could be cut or delegated.
ideas.details: Try the change, note the result, and share it with other managers.

ideas.title: Write down decisions clearly
ideas.summary: Name the decision, who made it, and why, in one shared place.
ideas.details: Keep a simple log: the decision, the owner, the date, the reasoning, and when it will be reviewed.

ideas.title: Protect focus time
ideas.summary: Block time in your calendar and keep it.
ideas.details: Set visible focus blocks and ask your team to respect them, and respect theirs.

ideas.title: Audit your team's meetings
ideas.summary: Review each recurring meeting: is it needed, and could it be shorter?
ideas.details: List every recurring meeting, keep the ones that earn their time, shorten or end the rest.

ideas.title: Default to asynchronous updates
ideas.summary: Share status in writing and keep meetings for decisions.
ideas.details: Agree as a team which updates move to writing, and revisit the agreement each quarter.

ideas.title: Open a feedback channel
ideas.summary: A standing agenda item, a shared doc, or an anonymous survey.
ideas.details: Choose one lightweight way for people to raise concerns, and respond to what comes in.

ideas.title: Close the loop on feedback
ideas.summary: Show what changed because of what people said.
ideas.details: After each round of feedback, share what you heard, what you will do, and what you won't.
